scientific_integrity: Direct finite-field and Hermitian-matrix proof; finite script checks corroborative. Scientific novelty is best knowledge and independent audit remains outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Planar-difference Alltop functions over odd characteristic p>=5 only
No noise-stability claim; maximin contrast is for coordinate impulses, not the global inverse-Lipschitz constant
Supplemented family still incomplete for general Hermitian matrix tomography
Known mutual unbiasedness and general rank-two kernel lemma are background, not novel assertions
title: Exact one-probe repair and complete phase fibers for Alltop Gabor measurements
